articles.title: 'I Was Ready To Pack My Bags And Leave Mumbai'
articles.excerpt:
'I was like I can't afford it. I cannot survive in Mumbai, so I will go back to the mountains.'
'But by God's grace, at that very moment, I got Adarsh Baal Vidyalaya, and Mumbai stopped me from leaving.'
